method: Every committed point comes from viewing the exact decoded frame: ffmpeg select=eq(n,IDX) absolute CFR indexing on the source recording (no -ss seeking), point measured on a zoomed pixel crop and re-verified in a 4x crop centered on the measured coordinate. No interpolation is presented as observation; ambiguous frames carry visibility=uncertain (no point) and full occlusions carry visibility=occluded (no point). Append-only sidecars devin-visual-v4-waveD2-ball.json; no existing annotation file modified.

clocks.afn-sasebo-rally2: CLIP clock via source mapping clip_n=source_n-918 on rec-6e06a3157947 (29.97fps); cross-registered against v1 ball points at 2500/2682 (agreement within ~0.01 normalized); residual alignment uncertainty <=1 frame (33ms), disclosed in the sidecar
